claim: omniseek_paper_enrich reports integrity.retracted=true with BOTH an expression_of_concern and a retraction notice for the 2005 Science stem-cell paper DOI 10.1126/science.1112286.
notes: Distinct notice profile from s5-scholar-005 (EoC+retraction vs correction+retraction), so it tests that the tool returns the real notice list rather than a boolean. Coverage caveat measured, not assumed: I probed four canonical pre-2003 physics retractions (10.1038/35021028, 10.1126/science.1065389, 10.1038/35042545) and the Crossref/Retraction-Watch feed returns retracted=false for all of them, so this feed is biomedical-skewed and pre-2003 physics cases must not be used as specimens.
